notes: Published v0.5.0 GitHub arm64 archive, not an earlier candidate.
Real repository pins and batch sizes match the historical v0.4 campaign. Allocation-only refresh; raw harness timings are retained but not promoted as website claims.
Additional isolated filesystem allocation after first status, including Git metadata; not exclusive per-file allocation or adopted-space savings.
Three paired rounds; separate image and seed per backend/round. No measured retries or silent exclusions. All correctness and native/private-write checks remain enabled.
Shared Apple M1 Ultra host, warm cache. No intentional competing tests, builds, or benchmark campaigns. No application code/dependencies executed.

A separate real-repository campaign was observed active on this Mac during preflight. These followups wait for it and any other observed real-bench worker to finish, then require 60 seconds without workers.
Known other active campaign controller PID59270: target/v05-real-20261117T234358. It is not modified or stopped.
Same published binary, frozen Git/harness, pins, 32-GiB image size, warmup, batch size and three paired repetitions as the original allocation campaign.

followupOf.reason: Owner requested reruns until allocation sampling settles; four original Git observations were unstable and remain unchanged.

stoppingRule.eligibility: First complete three-round paired campaign per repository where every before/afterStatus allocation sample is stable, all byte/mode/link/source/private-write checks pass, and Twig is native.
stoppingRule.selection: Stability only, independent of measured savings. Retain every attempt, stable or unstable; do not pool or silently discard attempts.
